# AnisetteKit source snapshot

This directory contains a source snapshot of [mahee96/AnisetteKit](https://github.com/mahee96/AnisetteKit) at commit `db8b41022697b6c19be8a5f01a1ce834145a2a26`, referenced by SideSign's locked dependencies. It is third-party AGPLv3 code, not recovered GPS source. The upstream license text is in `LICENSE`.

The local package omits tests. Local changes disable debug logging by default without evaluating log arguments and restrict authentication and provisioning requests, including redirects and Apple-supplied provisioning URLs, to HTTPS hosts under `apple.com`.
